annotations.title: Plan bills and a monthly budget

description: Helps with manual bill and budget planning, with no bank connection. Given a month's bills (name, amount, due date, paid or not) and/or planned income and spending categories (planned and actual amounts), it returns a bills checklist sorted by due date with the unpaid total and what is overdue or due in the next 7 days, each category's actual minus planned, and the plan difference (planned income minus planned category spending). A blank amount stays unknown, never zero, and bills are not added to category totals. With only a question, it explains how to set up a simple bills-and-budget board. Read-only: it stores nothing, connects to no bank and pays nothing. Not financial advice.

as_of.description: Today's date as YYYY-MM-DD, used for overdue and due-in-7-days. Omit to skip those.

paid.description: True if the user has marked it paid. Defaults to false.

actual.description: Actual spent so far, null if unknown.

currency.description: Currency for the figures. Defaults to USD.

planned_income.description: Planned income for the month. Omit or null if unknown.

question.description: The user's question in plain words, e.g. 'Which bills are still unpaid this month?' or 'How do I set up a budget without linking my bank?'

name: plan_bills_and_budget
title: Plan bills and a monthly budget
